// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_a2_stereo_reverse_depth {
    intent "Planar map with independent forward stereo and reverse depth views"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_rplidar_open_crown", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_lidar_spider", by = "under_holes")

    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a2m12", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "user_5v")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_oak_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_camera_rosbot", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", data = @core/chassis, port = "rear_usb_1", power = @core/chassis, output = "rear_usb_1_power")

    Mount device3_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_d435_rear_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "rear_camera_pair", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device3_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device3_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes", data = @core/chassis, port = "rear_usb_2", power = @core/chassis, output = "rear_usb_2_power")
}

// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_a3_reverse_depth_mapping {
    intent "Panoramic A3 mapping with rear depth observation"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_rplidar_open_crown", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_lidar_spider", by = "under_holes")

    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a3m1", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "user_5v")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_d435_rear_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "rear_camera_pair", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes", data = @core/chassis, port = "rear_usb_1", power = @core/chassis, output = "rear_usb_1_power")
}

// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_s3_floor_near_field {
    intent "Panoramic mapping, downward inspection and near-field front indication"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_s3_compact_crown", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_lidar_spider", by = "under_holes")

    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_s3", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "user_5v")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_d405_inspection_arm", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_camera_rosbot", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d405", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "tripod_hole", data = @core/chassis, port = "rear_usb_1", power = @core/chassis, output = "rear_usb_1_power")

    Mount device3_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_mb1010_nose_yoke", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_left_sensor", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic device3_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/device3_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "ext1_3v3")
}

// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_s3_near_field_navigation {
    intent "Raised planar scan plus a front near-field ultrasonic indicator"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_s3_compact_crown", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_lidar_spider", by = "under_holes")

    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_s3", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "user_5v")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_mb1010_nose_yoke", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_left_sensor", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic device2_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "ext1_3v3")
}

// Factory internal Pi 5 retained; no optional external computer is required.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_rosbot_sonar_floor_inspection {
    intent "Front ultrasonic indication while inspecting the floor"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_chassis")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_left", glue = (0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_front_right", glue = (0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_left", glue = (-0.085000000010, 0.1, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "husarion_rosbot_xl_mecanum_wheel_rear_right", glue = (-0.085000000010, -0.1, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_mb1010_nose_yoke", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_left_sensor", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic device1_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/chassis, output = "ext1_3v3")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_rosbot_oak_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "sight_camera_rosbot", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", data = @core/chassis, port = "rear_usb_1", power = @core/chassis, output = "rear_usb_1_power")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a2_mapping {
    intent "Raised planar mapping with A2"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a2m12", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a2_rgb_mapping {
    intent "Raised A2 mapping with forward RGB observation and a serviceable Pi 5"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a2m12", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_camera3_front_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device2_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "cam0_power", data = @core/computer, port = "cam0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a2_stereo_docking {
    intent "Planar map and stereo perception with a separate near-field docking sensor"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a2m12", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_oak_front_yoke_lite_pro", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount device3_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_vl53_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    // Carrier I2C logic follows VIN, so use the Pi 3.3 V rail with the Pi I2C bus.
    Range device3_sensor(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/device3_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_a3_surface_inspection {
    intent "Planar mapping while examining the surface below the nose"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_rplidar_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_a3m1", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_d405_inspection_arm", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d405", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "tripod_hole", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_camera3_front_cage {
    intent "forward RGB observation"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_camera3_front_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device1_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "cam0_power", data = @core/computer, port = "cam0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_oak_front_yoke_oak_d {
    intent "forward depth observation"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_oak_front_yoke", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device1_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_oak_front_yoke_oak_lite {
    intent "forward depth observation"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_oak_front_yoke_lite_pro", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device1_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_s3_depth_mapping {
    intent "Raised S3 mapping and forward depth on separate chassis channels"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_s3_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_s3", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_d435_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_s3_mapping {
    intent "Raised planar mapping with S3"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_s3_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_s3", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_s3_rgb_depth_mapping {
    intent "Panoramic S3 mapping with separate RGB and forward depth observations"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_scanner_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_s3_rear_portal", on = @core/chassis, at = "lidar_middle_channel", by = "under_holes")

    // Scanner needs at least 4.9 V; the retained 5 V regulator can fall to 4.85 V.
    // Leave its supply unresolved until a suitable retained power stage is selected.
    Lidar device1_scanner(ref = "husarion_rplidar_s3", on = @core/device1_scanner_mount, at = "scanner_holes", by = "mounting_holes", data = @core/computer, port = "uart0")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_camera3_front_cage", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Camera device2_sensor(ref = "raspberry_pi_camera_module_3", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "camera_pcb_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "cam0_power", data = @core/computer, port = "cam0")

    Mount device3_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_d435_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device3_sensor(ref = "realsense_d435", on = @core/device3_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_tof_stereo_docking {
    intent "Near-field docking ToF paired with forward stereo depth"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_vl53_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    // Carrier I2C logic follows VIN, so use the Pi 3.3 V rail with the Pi I2C bus.
    Range device1_sensor(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount device2_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_oak_front_yoke_lite_pro", on = @core/chassis, at = "front_right_l2", by = "under_holes")

    RGBD device2_sensor(ref = "luxonis_oak_d_lite", on = @core/device2_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "rear_75mm_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb3_0")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Shown Pi 5 has a real mounting chain; motor control, power regulation and electrical/data connections remain unresolved.
// Mechanical candidate; actual mounting interfaces are declared below.
Robot mount_strafer_vl53_front_fork {
    intent "near-field docking"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount device1_support(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_vl53_front_fork", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    // Carrier I2C logic follows VIN, so use the Pi 3.3 V rail with the Pi I2C bus.
    Range device1_sensor(ref = "pololu_vl53l4cd_carrier", on = @core/device1_support, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_compute_romi", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_romi_pi5", by = "under_holes")

}

// Mechanical design candidate; consult recorded geometry/access/load gates. Electrical, control and power systems are not completed by this example.
// Compute: added_pi5
Robot mount_v3_strafer_arm_compute {
    intent "Channel-supported arm, rear-left Pi5 and forward ultrasonic yoke"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount arm_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_arm_strafer_omx_channel_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx", by = "under_holes")

    Attachment arm(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

    Mount sensor_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_sensor_strafer_mb1010", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic front_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sensor_mount, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_blf_1215a_printable_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "bioenno_blf_1215a_lifepo4_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
    Mount hub_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_hub_front_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment power_hub(ref = "robotis_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/hub_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Attachment u2d2(ref = "robotis_u2d2_usb_c", on = @core/power_hub, at = "u2d2_capture", by = "rivet_lips", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb2_0")
}

// Mechanical design candidate; consult recorded geometry/access/load gates. Electrical, control and power systems are not completed by this example.
// Compute: added_pi5
Robot mount_v3_strafer_compute_sonar {
    intent "Rear-left Pi5 and front short-range ultrasonic sensor"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount sensor_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_sensor_strafer_mb1010", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_ultrasonic", by = "under_holes")

    Ultrasonic front_sensor(ref = "maxbotix_mb1010_lv_maxsonar_ez1", on = @core/sensor_mount, at = "sensor_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// The motor circuit uses the Romi battery compartment and screwed driver board.
// The rear carrier retains the Pi and three underside boards. See WIRING.md for
// soldered power, GPIO/PWM motor commands and unknown manufacturer limits.
Robot romi_lidar {
    intent "Pololu Romi differential base carrying a Unitree 4D LiDAR L2 and a MinIMU-9 inertial unit"

    Diff_two_caster chassis(ref = "pololu_romi_chassis_kit")

    Battery cells(ref = "pololu_romi_six_nimh_aa_cells", on = @core/chassis, at = "aa_compartment", by = "retained_cells")
    MotorDriver board(ref = "pololu_romi_motor_driver_power_board", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_board_screws", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/cells)

    Motor motor_left(ref = "pololu_mini_plastic_gearmotor_120_hp_offset_extended", glue = (0, 0.06269, 0, 0, 1, 0), command = @core/board)
    Motor motor_right(ref = "pololu_mini_plastic_gearmotor_120_hp_offset_extended", glue = (0, -0.06269, 0, 0, -1, 0), command = @core/board)

    Standard wheel_left(ref = "pololu_wheel_70x8mm", glue = (0, 0.0704, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Standard wheel_right(ref = "pololu_wheel_70x8mm", glue = (0, -0.0704, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Caster caster(ref = "pololu_romi_ball_caster", glue = (-0.06396984067436, -0.00000973866262, -0.02223, 0, 0, -1))

    // The second caster is purchased separately; it supports the front lidar installation.
    Caster caster_front(ref = "pololu_romi_ball_caster", glue = (0.04422, 0, -0.02223, 0, 0, -1))

    Mount lidar_mount(ref = "robotdsl_romi_l2_front_tower", on = @core/chassis, at = "v3_front_docking_sensor", by = "under_holes")
    Lidar3D lidar(ref = "unitree_4d_lidar_l2", on = @core/lidar_mount, at = "lidar_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/lidar_regulator, output = "vout", data = @core/computer, port = "ethernet")
    IMU imu(ref = "pololu_minimu_9_v6", on = @core/electronics, at = "imu_hole", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/computer, output = "gpio_3v3", data = @core/computer, port = "i2c1")

    Mount electronics(ref = "robotdsl_romi_lidar_electronics_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_romi_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/electronics, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/pi_regulator, output = "vout")
    Attachment pi_regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/electronics, at = "d42_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/cells)
    Attachment lidar_regulator(ref = "pololu_12v_2_5a_step_up_step_down_voltage_regulator_s13v25f12", on = @core/electronics, at = "s13_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/cells)
}

// A goBILDA Strafer as its kit builds it: the frame with its four motors, and the four mecanum wheels the kit brings.
Robot strafer {
    intent "goBILDA Strafer mecanum base with retained Pi/Motoron drive and a Gens ace traction battery"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_gensace_2200_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gensace_gea223s25t3gt_lipo_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")
}

// Complete declared power/control topology with a published-range alternative battery.
// Aggregate current remains undecided where manufacturers do not publish operating/startup bounds.
Robot strafer_arm_power {
    intent "One-arm Strafer with source-backed retention, motor controllers, USB/TTL interface and battery-fed power paths; Bioenno BLF-1215A on its printed retained tray"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "robotdsl_blf_1215a_printable_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "bioenno_blf_1215a_lifepo4_battery", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount arm_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_arm_strafer_omx_channel_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount hub_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_hub_front_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment power_hub(ref = "robotis_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/hub_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Attachment u2d2(ref = "robotis_u2d2_usb_c", on = @core/power_hub, at = "u2d2_capture", by = "rivet_lips", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb2_0")
}

// Complete nominal wiring topology; source NiMH output range is unknown, so its supply-voltage check stays undecided.
Robot strafer_arm_power_nimh {
    intent "One-arm Strafer with source-backed retention, motor controllers, USB/TTL interface and battery-fed power paths; original battery voltage envelope remains unpublished"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "gobilda_nested_battery_mount_1209_0001_0001", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gobilda_nimh_battery_12v_3000mah", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount arm_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_v3_arm_strafer_omx_channel_bridge", on = @core/chassis, at = "arm_strafer_omx", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment arm(ref = "robotis_openmanipulator_x_rm_x52_tnm", on = @core/arm_mount, at = "arm_case_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/power_hub, data = @core/u2d2, port = "ttl")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Mount hub_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/chassis, at = "power_hub_front_right", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment power_hub(ref = "robotis_u2d2_power_hub", on = @core/hub_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
    Attachment u2d2(ref = "robotis_u2d2_usb_c", on = @core/power_hub, at = "u2d2_capture", by = "rivet_lips", power = @core/computer, output = "usb_power", data = @core/computer, port = "usb2_0")
}

// Battery retention example. Install the supplied strap and four M4 screws/nuts.
// Motor controllers and power wiring remain unspecified; this is not a powered robot.
Robot strafer_battery {
    intent "Strafer kit with its recommended battery held by the dedicated strapped mount; Pi-controlled Motoron channels and regulated computer supply"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_holder(ref = "gobilda_nested_battery_mount_1209_0001_0001", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "gobilda_nimh_battery_12v_3000mah", on = @core/battery_holder, at = "battery")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment computer(ref = "raspberry_pi_5_8gb", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/regulator)
    MotorDriver drive_front(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_lower", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x10")
    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
}

// A goBILDA Strafer as its kit builds it: the frame with its four motors, and the four mecanum wheels the kit brings.
Robot strafer_bioenno_tray {
    intent "Nominal fit of a printed BLF-1215A battery tray on the Strafer rear-right rail; retained Pi/Motoron drive and regulated computer supply"

    Mecanum_four_wheel chassis(ref = "gobilda_strafer_chassis_kit_104mm")

    // The Strafer kit includes these four motors; retained 1:1 miter gears drive its wheel shafts.
    Motor motor_front_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, 0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_front_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (0.140, -0.156, 0, 1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_front, channel = "M2")
    Motor motor_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, 0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M1")
    Motor motor_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_yellow_jacket_5203_2402_0019", glue = (-0.140, -0.156, 0, -1, 0, 0), command = @core/drive_rear, channel = "M2")

    // A mecanum wheel has a hand: the same one goes front-left and rear-right, the other front-right and rear-left.
    Mecanum wheel_front_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_front_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_left(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fr_rl", glue = (-0.168, 0.207, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    Mecanum wheel_rear_right(ref = "gobilda_gripforce_mecanum_104mm_fl_rr", glue = (-0.168, -0.207, 0, 0, -1, 0))
    Mount battery_tray(ref = "robotdsl_blf_1215a_printable_tray", on = @core/chassis, at = "battery_rear_right", by = "mounting_holes")
    Battery battery(ref = "bioenno_blf_1215a_lifepo4_battery", on = @core/battery_tray, at = "battery")

    Mount compute_mount(ref = "robotdsl_strafer_pi5_motoron_carrier", on = @core/chassis, at = "compute_strafer_pi5", by = "under_holes")

    MotorDriver drive_rear(ref = "pololu_motoron_m2h18v20_dual_high_power_motor_controller_for_raspberry_pi_connectors_soldered", on = @core/compute_mount, at = "motoron_upper", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery, command = @core/computer, port = "i2c1", address = "0x11")

    Mount regulator_mount(ref = "robotdsl_mount_strafer_d42v110f5", on = @core/chassis, at = "regulator_front_left", by = "under_holes")
    Attachment regulator(ref = "pololu_d42v110f5_5v_regulator", on = @core/regulator_mount, at = "board_holes", by = "mounting_holes", power = @core/battery)
}
